author: BBC Earth
description:
For these tiny turtles, the journey to the ocean is anything but easy.

After 60 days beneath the sand, these tiny green turtle hatchlings emerge into a world filled with dangers their ancestors never faced. With the ocean just metres away, an unexpected challenge stands between them and their new life.

Blue Planet III returns to uncover extraordinary new stories and lives hidden beneath our oceans. Find out where to watch the full series 👉 https://www.bbcearth.com/shows/blue-planet-iii
